description: This file defines the Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection class, which wraps XML-RPC system.* introspection methods such as listing methods and retrieving method signatures via multicall or individual calls.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection
classes.description: A class that provides methods to perform system.* introspection on an XML-RPC server, including listing methods and retrieving signatures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a client proxy to perform introspection.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethod
methods.description: Retrieves signatures for all methods, attempting multicall first, then falling back to looping.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByMulticall
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve all method signatures in a single multicall request.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByLooping
methods.description: Retrieves method signatures by calling system.methodSignature for each method individually.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature for a specific method.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Lists all available methods on the server.
